response.rationale: R4 uniquely integrates the laparoscopic tubal/cornual origin with the smooth-muscle IHC profile (desmin/SMA/ER/PR positive, pan-CK negative), making it the most precise diagnosis. R3 captures the leiomyoma pathology but mislocates the mass as uterine, while C1 is only an append-only adnexal completion of R3. R7 is disconfirmed by the CK-negative/desmin-positive profile; R1 and R5 are excluded by the benign frozen section and absent mitotic atypia; R6 is unsupported by the pathology.

rejected.why: Append-only completion of R3; cites only adnexal imaging and lacks the tubal laparoscopic origin and pathology/IHC.
Adenomyosis is not supported by the pathology; the lesion is a well-demarcated smooth-muscle neoplasm, not endometrial glands/stroma.
STUMP is contradicted by the benign frozen section, well-demarcated border, and absence of mitotic atypia.
Adenomatoid tumor is disconfirmed by negative pan-cytokeratin and positive desmin/SMA/ER/PR, indicating smooth muscle rather than mesothelial differentiation.
Leiomyosarcoma is contradicted by the benign frozen section, well-demarcated border, and loose fibromyxoid stroma without mitotic atypia.
